text: いけそうな　みちや　まちに　どんどん　すすんで　みましょう！

structure.jp: いけそうな　みちや　まちに
structure.en: to roads and towns that look reachable

structure.jp: すすんで　みましょう！

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks like)
patterns.explanation: そう on the stem of a verb says it looks as if that would happen; with な it describes the next thing. いけそうな　みち = 'roads that look like you can go there'.

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.span: すすんで　みましょう
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb with みる means to try doing something to see what happens. すすんで　みましょう = 'let's try pressing on'.
